name: Tianli International Holdings Limited
summary: Tianli International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides education management and diversified services in China. It offers comprehensive education service, including kindergarten, high school, and Gaokao repetition education service, as well as sports and study tour services. The company also offers management and education consulting services. The company was formerly known as Tianli Education International Holdings Limited and changed its name to Tianli International Holdings Limited in June 2022. Tianli International Holdings Limited was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Chengdu, the People's Republic of China.
